ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima 'Contagious Interview' — node.exe BeaverTail wallet/keychain theft chain
ucs.description: Hunts the BeaverTail JavaScript stealer that DPRK's Famous Chollima (a.k.a. UNC5342 / DEV#POPPER / 'Contagious Interview') drops during fake developer job interviews: a malicious npm package or a 'recruiter' code-test repo is opened in VS Code, node.exe executes the trojanised module, and the payload reads MetaMask/browser-extension wallet stores plus keychains and POSTs them out. The combination of node.exe reading Local Extension Settings paths + outbound HTTP to a non-CDN host is the actor's fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=node.exe (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Code.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","explorer.exe","node.exe","npm.cmd","npm.exe","yarn.cmd")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_id Processes.process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=inner dest process_id [| tstats summariesonly=t count from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.process_name=node.exe (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Local Extension Settings\\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Login Data*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Keychains\\login.keychain*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\.config\\solana\\id.json*") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_id Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`] | join type=inner dest process_id [| tstats summariesonly=t values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as remoteIp values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as remotePort from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.process_name=node.exe All_Traffic.dest_port IN (80,443,1244,3000,5000,7777) NOT (All_Traffic.dest IN ("registry.npmjs.org","*.githubusercontent.com","github.com")) by All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.process_id] | eval risk_object=user, threat_object="BeaverTail/InvisibleFerret stealer chain" | table firstTime dest user parent cmdline file_path remoteIp remotePort
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WalletPaths = dynamic(["\\Local Extension Settings\\nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn","\\Local Extension Settings\\ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm","\\Local Extension Settings\\fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp","\\Local Extension Settings\\hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad","\\Login Data","\\.config\\solana\\id.json","\\Keychains\\login.keychain"]);
let NodeExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName =~ "node.exe" or FileName =~ "node"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("Code.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","explorer.exe","node.exe","npm.cmd","npm.exe","yarn.cmd")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project NodeTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, NodePid = ProcessId,
              ParentName = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              NodeCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let WalletReads = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where FolderPath has_any (WalletPaths) or FileName has_any ("Login Data","login.keychain","id.json","key3.db","key4.db","logins.json")
    | project FileTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, NodePid = InitiatingProcessId, TargetPath = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName);
let EgressNoCdn = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where not(RemoteUrl has_any ("registry.npmjs.org","githubusercontent.com","github.com","nodejs.org","yarnpkg.com"))
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, NodePid = InitiatingProcessId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort;
NodeExec
| join kind=inner WalletReads on DeviceId, NodePid
| join kind=inner EgressNoCdn on DeviceId, NodePid
| where datetime_diff('minute', FileTime, NodeTime) between (-2 .. 30)
  and datetime_diff('minute', NetTime, FileTime) between (-5 .. 30)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(NodeTime), WalletHits = dcount(TargetPath),
            SampleWallet = any(TargetPath), Beacons = make_set(strcat(RemoteUrl,":",tostring(RemotePort)), 10),
            SampleCmd = any(NodeCmd), SampleParent = any(ParentCmd)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, NodePid
| where WalletHits >= 1
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WalletKeywords = dynamic(["nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn","ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm","fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp","hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad","Login Data","login.keychain","solana\\id.json","logins.json"]);
let NodeExec = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName endswith "\\node.exe"
    | where ParentProcessName has_any ("\\Code.exe","\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\explorer.exe","\\npm.cmd","\\node.exe","\\yarn.cmd")
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project NodeTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, NodePid = NewProcessId,
              ParentProcessName, CommandLine;
let WalletReads = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActingProcessName endswith "\\node.exe"
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (WalletKeywords)
    | project FileTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActingProcessId, TargetFilePath;
NodeExec
| join kind=inner (WalletReads) on $left.Computer == $right.DvcHostname, $left.NodePid == $right.ActingProcessId
| where datetime_diff('minute', FileTime, NodeTime) between (-2 .. 30)
| summarize FirstSeen = min(NodeTime), WalletHits = dcount(TargetFilePath),
            SampleWallet = any(TargetFilePath), SampleCmd = any(CommandLine), SampleParent = any(ParentProcessName)
            by Computer, Account, NodePid
| where WalletHits >= 1
| order by FirstSeen desc

ucs.rationale: Famous Chollima (UNC5342, DEV#POPPER, 'Contagious Interview') has a uniquely narrow execution profile: victims are developers who run an attacker-supplied npm package or 'coding challenge' repo via node.exe under VS Code/cmd/npm. BeaverTail's signature behaviour is reading the exact MetaMask, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet and BNB extension IDs above, plus Chromium 'Login Data' and the Solana CLI keysto

ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima ClickFix — fake CAPTCHA pasting curl/mshta to fetch InvisibleFerret loader
ucs.description: Hunts the ClickFix social-engineering variant Famous Chollima rolled into Contagious Interview in 2025: candidates are told to 'verify their camera' on a fake recruiter portal, which copies a curl/iwr/mshta one-liner into the clipboard and instructs them to paste it into Run/Terminal. The resulting parent (explorer.exe Run dialog or Terminal) → cmd/powershell/mshta → curl/HTTP fetch chain with the Python loader staged to %TEMP% is the actor's tell.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmdline from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","OpenWith.exe") Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe") (Processes.process="*curl*http*" OR Processes.process="*iwr *" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-WebRequest*" OR Processes.process="*Invoke-RestMethod*" OR Processes.process="*Start-BitsTransfer*" OR Processes.process="*mshta*http*" OR Processes.process="*certutil*-urlcache*") (Processes.process="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp*" OR Processes.process="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*nvidia*" OR Processes.process="*update*" OR Processes.process="*driver*" OR Processes.process="*camera*" OR Processes.process="*captcha*" OR Processes.process="*verif*" OR Processes.process="*.py" OR Processes.process="*python*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where user!="SYSTEM" AND NOT match(user,"\$$") | eval risk_object=user, threat_object="Famous Chollima ClickFix paste-execution" | table firstTime dest user parent_process_name process_name parent_cmdline cmdline
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let PasteParents = dynamic(["explorer.exe","WindowsTerminal.exe","OpenWith.exe","Run.exe"]);
let DownloadVerbs = dynamic(["curl http","curl -o","curl.exe http","iwr ","Invoke-WebRequest","Invoke-RestMethod","Start-BitsTransfer","certutil -urlcache","certutil.exe -urlcache","mshta http","mshta.exe http","bitsadmin /transfer"]);
let ChollimaLures = dynamic(["nvidia","camera","captcha","verif","driver","willo","chrome-update","webcam","realtek"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PasteParents)
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","curl.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (DownloadVerbs)
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (ChollimaLures)
   or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\","\\Users\\Public\\","%TEMP%",".py","python")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Url = extract(@"(https?://[^\s\"']+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend Lure = extract(@"(?i)(nvidia|camera|captcha|verif|driver|willo|webcam|realtek|chrome-update)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Child = FileName,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          Url, Lure, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let DownloadVerbs = dynamic(["curl http","curl -o","iwr ","Invoke-WebRequest","Invoke-RestMethod","Start-BitsTransfer","certutil -urlcache","mshta http","bitsadmin /transfer"]);
let ChollimaLures = dynamic(["nvidia","camera","captcha","verif","driver","willo","chrome-update","webcam","realtek"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("\\explorer.exe","\\WindowsTerminal.exe","\\OpenWith.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any ("\\cmd.exe","\\powershell.exe","\\pwsh.exe","\\mshta.exe","\\curl.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (DownloadVerbs)
| where CommandLine has_any (ChollimaLures)
   or CommandLine has_any ("\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\","\\Users\\Public\\",".py","python")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Url = extract(@"(https?://[^\s\"']+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName,
          Parent = ParentProcessName, Child = NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, Url
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Famous Chollima ClickFix Paste-Execution to Stage Loader
id: 9e2c1c4d-7a3b-4f9c-b621-83e4cd14f9ab
status: experimental
description: Detects the DPRK Famous Chollima 'ClickFix' fake-CAPTCHA / fake-recruiter paste-execution flow where explorer.exe (Run dialog) or Windows Terminal directly spawns cmd/powershell/mshta with an HTTP downloader and a Chollima-flavoured lure path or staging dir.
references:
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/contagious-interview-clickfix/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/contagious-interview-clickfix
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/06/16
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.004
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1059.003
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\WindowsTerminal.exe'
      - '\OpenWith.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
  selection_download:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'curl http'
      - 'curl -o'
      - 'iwr '
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'Invoke-RestMethod'
      - 'Start-BitsTransfer'
      - 'certutil -urlcache'
      - 'mshta http'
      - 'bitsadmin /transfer'
  selection_lure:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'nvidia'
      - 'camera'
      - 'captcha'
      - 'verif'
      - 'driver'
      - 'willo'
      - 'webcam'
      - 'realtek'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '.py'
      - 'python'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_download and selection_lure
falsepositives:
  - Helpdesk-driven self-service driver / camera fixes pasted into Run by users
  - Developer one-off downloads from explorer.exe Run dialog
level: high
